frames.book: book_<dir>_<phase>_<f>: open_0..3 (pop, closed, half, open), hold_0..2 (open, page corner lifts, page stands), close_0..2 (half, closed, pop), write_0..3 (open + quill scribble)
frames.bookghost: bookghost_<dir>_<phase>_<f>: the same set in the ghost family (dead players keep notes too)

bigBook.option: bookStyle: 'held' (default, book_*) | 'big' (live: a 3D book in the scene graph; port: bookbig_<dir>_*) | 'held3d' (live only, opt-in: the 3D model at held size at the held grip; evaluated, not the default) | 'bigsprite' (mock HUD: the port sprites); live via hud.uiOptions.bookStyle / setOptions(hud, {bookStyle}); mock HUD ?book=big|bigsprite
bigBook.frames: bookbig_<dir>_<phase>_<f> / bookbigghost_<dir>_<phase>_<f>, dir = v2 point dir names: open_0..5 (pop, closed + rise, cover lifts, cover past upright + leaves trail, cover falls + leaves fan, open), hold_0..4 (open, page corner lifts, page stands, passes upright, lands left), close_0..3 (cover rises, nearly shut, closed, pop away), write_0..3 (quill writes the near line, ink grows)
bigBook.anchor: per dir: the READER'S FEET texel inside the frame (draw at feet - anchors[dir]); ghost frames include the 0.2 m hover
bigBook.depth: avatar depth + epsilon (always over its own reader, under name labels / bubbles / the finger); the live book does the same with a view-space depth bias

render.camera: yaw 0, pitch 30 deg, orthographic, vh 12 (30 texels/m at 640x360)
render.note: colours come from the toon renderer (3D lit), not from UI tokens: excluded from the palette audit below

notebook.book: tier A-depth: a depth-tested billboard at the hand point (src/ui/notebook/draw.js, pinPass instance at order 302: masked by L.world so labels / bubbles / the pointing finger stay on top; hidden by the reader's own body when facing away and by anyone standing in front)
notebook.page: tier S (panel) + CSS (DOM textarea skin, out/ui/notebook.css; opt-in pixel webfont .ctn-pixelfont)
